name: BART
description: High-Value Discount: 6.25% bonus value on BART when using Clipper Autoload
fullDescription: BART (Bay Area Rapid Transit) is a heavy rail rapid transit system serving the San Francisco Bay Area, connecting San Francisco, Oakland, Berkeley, and surrounding suburbs with 50 stations across 131 miles of track.
whatTheyOffer:
- High-Value Discount (HVD): 6.25% savings for adult Clipper cards ($48 of BART value for $45, or $64 for $60)
- Available only by setting up Autoload on a registered Clipper card or through a transit benefit program
- Works on all BART stations and routes
howToGetIt:
1. Get an adult Clipper card and register it in an online Clipper account
2. In your Clipper account, select Add Value, then Transit Pass, then BART
3. Choose the HVD amount and set it up as Autoload
4. The bonus value is added each time the Autoload reloads
keywords: BART, Bay Area Rapid Transit, train, Clipper, Autoload, discount, subway, rail, commute, San Francisco, Oakland
